name: Workspace App Access Level Weakened
description: BeyondCorp and Workspace access levels decide which apps a user can open based on device and identity. Weakening a level is like loosening Conditional Access: more people, more devices, fewer checks. Attackers do this so a stolen laptop or an unmanaged phone can reach Gmail or Drive. Access-level edits should be owned by the identity team, not by a helpdesk role. A weaker level plus a later suspicious login is the one-two punch.
mitigations: Rotate credentials if the actor is compromised
